主要内容: On March 7, 2018, KENTUCKY BANCSHARES, INC. announced a quarterly cash dividend of 31 cents per share, an increase from the previous quarter's 29 cents per share. The dividend will be paid to shareholders of record as of March 15, 2018, on March 30, 2018. The announcement was made in a press release dated March 7, 2018, and is included as Exhibit 99.1 in the Form 8-K filing. The company is a financial services provider based in Kentucky, operating under the ticker symbol KTYB on the US market. The dividend reflects the company's ongoing financial performance and commitment to shareholder returns. The filing is part of the company's regular reporting obligations under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. No additional financial details or market impacts are disclosed in the text. The company's annual report and other filings are available on the SEC website and its corporate website, www.kybank.com.
